name: io.github.iaptic/mcp-server-iaptic
title: Iaptic
description: Query Iaptic in-app purchase data: customers, purchases, transactions, events and stats.

environmentVariables.name: IAPTIC_APP_NAME
environmentVariables.description: Your Iaptic app name (shown in the Iaptic dashboard Settings).

environmentVariables.name: IAPTIC_API_KEY
environmentVariables.description: Your Iaptic app's Secret Key (dashboard Settings). Required unless IAPTIC_MASTER_KEY is set.

environmentVariables.name: IAPTIC_MASTER_KEY
environmentVariables.description: Optional master key to manage several apps from one server. Replaces the API key; every data tool then takes an appName argument.
